channel.title: Wire — Frontend
channel.description: Frontend from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: The team behind Tailwind CSS is joining Shopify
item.description: We're joining Shopify to give Tailwind a stable long-term home where it will be actively maintained for the millions of people who depend on it. (5 sources: frontendfocus, hackernews, nodeweekly, reactstatus, rubyweekly)

item.title: Advancing Embedded Go: Recoverable Panics, UEFI, Radio and Hardware Dev Kit
item.description: TinyGo version 0.42 introduces significant updates, including recoverable panics and support for Go 1.27 and LLVM 22, improving error handling and enabling Go code to run as UEFI applications. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Antiquated CSS and why we needed it
My HTML Boilerplate
item.description: A document outlining and explaining my general structure for HTML pages to use. A slim general markup template that applies to almost all HTML documents on the web and forgoes anything unnecessary. (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: W3C Opens Its 2026 Community Survey
item.description: W3C opens an 8-minute survey until 30 September and seeks community-wide input to get to know our community better, investigate needs, and understand how we can improve. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: Interop 2027 proposals are open until September 23
moved to a two-week release cycle
item.description: Google is speeding up Chrome’s release schedule to ship security patches and new features faster. (1 source: frontendfocus)

Creating a Custom Scrollbar Component in 2026
item.description: Thanks to some very modern CSS, we can visually replicate the logic of scrollbars. Then make them actually functional. (1 source: frontendfocus)
